business_problem: Vinli needed a better way to support AI-powered fleet intelligence, risk surfacing, and workflow automation because fleet operators needed a scalable way to unify OEM, telematics, and driver data so new AI products could launch faster without heavy infrastructure overhead.
solution_summary: Vinli uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support AI-powered fleet intelligence, risk surfacing, and workflow automation. The implementation replaced a legacy state where fleet operators needed a scalable way to unify OEM, telematics, and driver data so new AI products could launch faster without heavy infrastructure overhead. Oem data and telematics feeds move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Model Serving, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver fleet risk alerts and cost-saving recommendations.
business_outcome: Vinli improved AI-powered fleet intelligence, risk surfacing, and workflow automation with measurable results including 40% revolutionizing fleet intelligence with ai-powered operations, 2–3x faster time to market for ai-powered product launches, and 30% increase in scalability and workload performance, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
